title: Four Qualifying Dates for Turning 18
summary: Since the Election Laws (Amendment) Act enabled it on ECI's recommendation, there are four qualifying dates each year for age-18 eligibility — 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October — instead of only 1 January.
body: You can register as a new voter once you turn 18, without waiting for the next 1 January. If you turn 18 any time between 2 January and 1 April, you become eligible on the 1 April qualifying date; between 2 April and 1 July, you qualify on 1 July; between 2 July and 1 October, you qualify on 1 October; and between 2 October and the next 1 January, you qualify on 1 January. You can submit Form 6 in advance of your qualifying date so your registration is ready to process as soon as you become eligible — check the official portal for how far in advance advance-applications are accepted.
